BEFORE YOU BUY

KNOW WHAT
YOU’RE CHOOSING.

Actual product specifications and terms
must come from the live catalog.

HOW DO I CHOOSE MY SIZE?

Measure a garment you already like laid flat: chest width, body length and sleeve length. Compare those measurements with the exact product’s size chart in Magento. These illustrative concepts do not have confirmed garment measurements.

REGULAR OR OVERSIZED?

Fit depends on the actual blank and pattern. “Oversized” cannot be inferred from an illustration. Check product-specific measurements and model information before ordering.

HOW LONG WILL MY ORDER TAKE?

Production time, shipping cost and delivery estimates are not connected to this preview. Confirm them in the live Magento checkout before paying.

WHAT DOES LIMITED EDITION MEAN?

A real drop must state its actual quantity, sales window or limited variant. This preview does not claim a numbered edition or display an artificial stock countdown.

HOW SHOULD I CARE FOR MY GARMENT?

Follow the care label and product-specific print instructions supplied with the actual garment. A care sheet will be added once the fabric and printing method are confirmed.

RETURNS, SHIPPING & ORDER SUPPORT

Use the current policies and contact details in the Magento store. This Site does not yet accept orders, process returns or provide order tracking.
